Class MessageToServer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.Controller.Client.MessagesToServer.MessageToServer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
ActiveGamesRequestMTS, CanIPlayMTS, ChooseSecretObjectiveMTS, DrawCardMTS, EndTurnMTS, GetObjectivesMTS, HandShakeMTS, NewGameMTS, PeekPlayerMTS, PlaceCardMTS, RemoveLastPlayedCardMTS, ViewUtilitiesMTS
public abstract class MessageToServer extends Object implements Serializable
Abstract class representing a message sent from the client to the server. Implements Serializable to allow objects to be serialized. Subclasses must implement the update() method.
